summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Omnisys Ltd., an Israeli company, for approximately $199 million in common stock consideration. The purchase price consists of $29 million in stock at closing, $142.5 million in five equal installments post-closing, and the remainder by the 24th trading day after closing. Shareholders may earn up to $60 million in additional contingent stock-based earn-out payments over three years. The boards of both companies provided customary reps and warranties. The deal is subject to Omnisys shareholder consent, regulatory approvals, and no adverse orders. The stock consideration avoids cash outlay but dilutes equity; the earn-out aligns incentives. Risk-arb watchers should monitor shareholder approval and regulatory timelines.
